perDirectionSelection: highest screening share, earlier checkpoint wins ties
promotion: Positive tie-adjusted share gain versus incumbent AND lower endpoint of approximate paired 99% interval >0; five comparisons use Bonferroni-style familywise 5% threshold
plateau: If none of the five follow-up directions meets the promotion rule after completing its budget, treat this setup as practically plateaued and perform one untouched final test; this is not proof of a global optimum
